node.title: SOV active-core obstruction vanishing
node.statement: Every active h-core in the intended h>20 band corresponds to a finite h-trade whose locator L satisfies the forced-root obstruction equations, so all obstruction coordinates from sov_forced_root_recursion_algebra vanish.
node.attack_surface: connect active-core equations to the finite h-trade square-shift model used by X79, uniformly for h in the intended band
node.falsifier: an active h-core whose locator is not in the square-shift trade model or has a nonzero forced-root obstruction coordinate
